description: Shared types for Garazyk content-addressed VOD records (WS12 / ADR 0036).

aspectRatio.description: Width/height of the primary visual rendition.

rendition.description: One adaptive-bitrate ladder entry described by the MASL manifest.

name.description: Variant directory name used in the MASL bundle (e.g. 720p).

bandwidth.description: Nominal peak bitrate in bits per second.

byteRange.description: Inclusive byte offset and length for a flat-VOD first segment (or init+first).

playbackBootstrap.description: Prefetch-critical metadata so a feed client can start the next item without a record→manifest→segment discovery chain (ADR 0037 / WS12 Phase 8).

cid.description: Record CID for the video identity.

manifestCid.description: SHA-256 CID of the DRISL/MASL manifest blob.

playlist.description: Resolved /watch master playlist URL when a known origin is attached.

firstSegmentPath.description: MASL-relative media path for the first playable range (e.g. /720p/video.fmp4).

firstSegmentBytes.description: Declared byte budget for the first-segment prefetch (waste accounting).

providers.description: Mutable provider hint URLs suitable for immediate fetch (from origin attestations).
